title: Simple Misgivings
source: camelot.allakhazam.com/quests.html?cquest=69 (retold in our own words; levels, the 480 experience and 5 silver from its completion log)
offer: My old helper Quirk took my forge plans and ran off to a huldu camp. Bring them back to me and I will pay you for the trouble.
complete: These are the very plans. You have my thanks, and a little coin for the walk.

steps.text: Find Quirk in the huldu camp west of Mularn and take back Hilde's forge plans.
Bring the forge plans to Hilde.
